$comment: The words the page says, in English, each with its translation. Write the translation in the empty string after a text; a text left empty stays in English. {0}, {1}… stand for what the page puts in the text (a name, a number) and go where the translation wants them. Kept up to date by `node tools/i18n.js`, which keeps every translation written here and adds the new texts.
